verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robot simulator. Capturing telemetry on a physical robot and syncing it to the cloud under bandwidth-aware policies belongs to fleet and data-platform tools, so this axis does not apply. The evidence covers only simulated sensor generation (gz-sim) and generic pub/sub messaging (gz-transport), which are developer building blocks, not on-robot capture or cloud sync.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture sensor and telemetry data on-robot and sync it to the cloud with bandwidth-aware policies
